title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Duo #19 (L:대각 띠·물결 / C:부채꼴·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Spanish woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, bold and confident, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 26% of the way down her figure from the top, about 51% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both arms raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Indian woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, sultry, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 43% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 8 o'clock, 11 o'clock, 3 o'clock and 5 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 11 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following the contours of the body, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 11 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, dense overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 4 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, dense floral medallion border filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto ankle boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
